verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent and annual report services document reminders for annual report deadlines, real-time compliance status notifications, and customized compliance alerts, which map to filing-deadline reminders. However, no evidence shows a dedicated 'compliance calendar' view aggregating multiple filing types, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of these alert features actually working as described. Missing for 10: a visual compliance calendar UI, evidence covering multiple deadline types beyond annual reports, and independent user validation of alert reliability.
